# VFX

> Pooled visual-effect registry.

- Package: `VFX` · Category: Effects
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: [Pool](Pool.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("VFX")` (server) / `Gaxia.IsInstalled("VFX")` (shared/client keys)

## `GaxiaServer.VFX`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/VFXService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local VFX = GaxiaServer.VFX
```

### Functions

- `VFX.Register(name: string, build: EffectBuilder): ()`
- `VFX.PreWarm(name: string, n: number): ()`
- `VFX.GetPoolSize(name: string): number`

  `where` is a world position (Vector3) or a full CFrame.
- `VFX.Attach(name: string, host: BasePart, opts: PlayOpts?): () -> ()`
